people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Zacchaeus
people.line: Tax collector who hosted Jesus in Jericho

translations.web: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”
translations.bsb: When Jesus came to that place, He looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, hurry down, for I must stay at your house today.”
translations.kjv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
translations.asv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to-day I must abide at thy house.
